summary: 작은 새나 곤충 등을 주로 먹는다. 울창한 숲속에 둥지를 틀고 5월 무렵 알 2개를 낳는다. 산지가 훼손되어 사는 곳이 파괴되는 것이 가장 큰 위협이다.

points.en: white throat with a thin dark mesial stripe
whitish underwing with dark-barred flight feathers

sexes.male: 윗면이 짙은 청회색이고, 가슴에서 옆구리까지 옅은 적갈색을 띠며 홍채가 검붉다.
sexes.female: 수컷보다 크고 윗면이 회갈색이며, 흰 아랫면에 짙은 갈색 가로줄이 촘촘하고 홍채가 노랗다.

young: 어린새는 암수 모두 윗면이 짙은 갈색이고 흰 눈썹선이 있으며, 흰 아랫면의 가슴에는 갈색 세로무늬, 배와 옆구리에는 굵은 갈색 반점과 가로무늬가 있다.

similar.how: 새매는 더 크고 꼬리가 길며, 멱 가운데 검은 세로줄이 없고 흰 눈썹선이 뚜렷하다.
조롱이는 꼬리가 더 짧고 꼬리의 검은 띠가 옅은 띠보다 가늘며, 앉았을 때 날개 끝이 꼬리 중간까지 온다.

art.subject: Japanese Sparrowhawk (Accipiter gularis), adult male, as seen in Korean forests in late spring: crown, nape, back and upperwings dark slate-grey; face grey; throat white with a thin, faint dark central (mesial) stripe; breast and flanks washed warm orange-buff, clearly coloured rather than white, with faint fine barring; belly and undertail coverts white. Tail grey with several distinct dark cross-bands. Underwing whitish with dark barring on the flight feathers. Iris deep red; cere yellow; bill short, dark and sharply hooked; legs long and thin, yellow, with long slender toes.
art.pose: perched on a branch inside dense forest, side view
art.scene: dense Korean forest interior in late spring; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched on a branch: dark slate-grey upperparts, grey face, deep red iris, yellow cere, white throat with a thin dark mesial stripe, orange-buff breast and flanks with faint fine barring, white belly and undertail coverts, short wings falling well short of the dark-banded grey tail, long thin yellow legs

adult male, in flight seen squarely from below: short, rounded wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, about twice the body length, whitish underwing with dark-barred flight feathers and no black tips, white throat, orange-buff breast and flanks, white vent, dark-banded grey tail, yellow feet tucked under the tail
art.build: Very small hawk, smaller than a Feral Pigeon and lightly built, about the length of a Brown-eared Bulbul but stockier; the smallest Accipiter in Korea. Rounded head with no crest. Short, rounded wings whose tips fall well short of the tail tip at rest. Tail medium-long and square-ended, grey with several distinct dark cross-bands. Legs long and very thin for the size. Moves through dense forest and darts out after small birds; flight is quick flaps and short glides.
avoid: Do not paint a plain whitish underwing with black tips and a swollen orange cere (Chinese Sparrowhawk).
Do not paint a bold white supercilium or orange cheeks (Eurasian Sparrowhawk).
Do not give the adult male a yellow iris; that marks the female.
Do not paint a large, heavy hawk; this is a tiny, delicate Accipiter.
